steps.content: Christina is somewhat relieved that the two crime scenes aren't too far apart. They don't have much time left. If she is right, then...
There is something wrong with the case at the third scene. Perhaps, Eugean didn't die at the hands of the Mentor.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: The Mentor meticulously planned this. She even violated her own principles and forcibly created a fourth scene, just to cover this up.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: If the criminal has something to hide, we must uncover it!
She storms into the conference room. This time, she will unravel the lies beneath the lies.
